children: is looking to add production capacity in Europe with its current partner Austria's Magna and also with other investors, GAC France's deputy CEO Cedric Lacour said on Monday.

"We are currently looking into production capacity in Europe, both with Magna and with other investors. We are  studying this. We are promoting (the slogan) 'in Europe, for Europe' everywhere, so we really want to establish a long-term presence here, which automatically means we need production capacity," he told Reuters on the sidelines of the launch of GAC's first two car models in France.
